title: Leprosy and Skin Disease
summary: Biblical “leprosy” language covers serious skin conditions and carried social, ceremonial, and worship-related consequences.
background: Leviticus provides procedures for priestly examination, isolation, cleansing, and restoration. In the Gospels, Jesus’ cleansing of lepers shows compassion, authority, and restoration.
teachingHelp: Avoid assuming modern Hansen’s disease in every case. Explain uncleanness, isolation, and restoration to community worship.
